title: bot.ability.memory.stm.record
description: Short-term memory record. stimulus_name is the admitted event name; payload carries only bounded identifier-like scalar projections of the stimulus data.

stimulus_name.description: Name of the admitted stimulus event (e.g. environment.sound).
stimulus_name.title: Stimulus Name

payload.description: Bounded scalar projection of the stimulus data: top-level identifier-like fields only. Media bytes, long strings, and nested structures are omitted.
payload.title: Payload

event_id.description: Envelope id of the stimulus event.
event_id.title: Event Id

source.description: Envelope source address of the stimulus event.
source.title: Source

target.description: Envelope target address of the stimulus event.
target.title: Target
